question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Chill out
solution:
The correct answer is: **Relax completely**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Chill out**' means to relax after you have done something tiring or stressful.

 
 
• Example - *Just **chill out__**, panicking about being late won't make me drive any faster.*
 
 

So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Chill out**' is 'Relax completely.'

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
